Name: Wild Flower Foraging
Author: stardewmoddingteen
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
This mod allows flowers to spawn anywhere in the valley (Except the Farm and Town). The higher the sell price of the flower, the rarer it is for it to spawn!

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
After unzipping the mod, place the folder named 'Wild Flower Foraging' into your mods folder, and you can start playing!

[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
- Flowers spawn in the valley.
- The higher the sell price of the flower, the rarer it is for it to spawn.

[b]Odds listed below:[/b]
Spring: 61.5% Tulip, 30.8% Blue Jazz, 7.7% Fairy Rose
Summer: 61.5% Summer Spangle, 30.8% Poppy, 7.7% Fairy Rose
Fall: 80% Sunflower, 20% Fairy Rose
Winter: Flowers don't spawn.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
The SMAPI mod, the Content Patcher mod and the Farm Type Manager mod are required for this mod.

[b][size=4]Shoutouts[/size][/b]
A huge thank you to everyone playing with this mod!
